message: ライヴァルは誰だ!?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey... Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For this upcoming exam, you and I are in the same boat, right? Your scholarship status is on the line, and I'm on the verge of failing」

name: Synn
message: 「Now that you mention it, we're kindred spirits」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, you know, I was thinking maybe we could band together and get through this crisis--or something」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll lend you my class notes like always」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not banding together at all! I'm saying let's have a study session together!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, I figured... I'd just hold you back, huh... ahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not it. I already promised to study with Azel」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehhh, with Azel!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not with Ria-senpai!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why Ria-senpai?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uh, well, um, you know, she doesn't have tests so she's free」

name: Synn
message: 「Studying with Senpai would be way too intimidating」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right, ahaha... Even though I thought my rival was Ria-senpai...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm, is something wrong?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, if it's Azel, against a total boob guy like Synn, I should still have the advantage... But, but even so, he specifically chose Azel!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Heeeey, Nanaka!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-What's the big idea! You startled me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Something the matter?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-Nothing at all. Ahahahaha」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're a pitiful one too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up!」
Did Azel already go ahead to the library?
Ah.
Huh?
Over there is Azel and...

name: Pasta
message: 「Sigh... I don't even want to talk to someone like that, nya」

name: Azel
message: 「Then don't」
An unusual pair.

name: Pasta
message: 「Just as I thought, consulting you was a total waste of time, nya」

name: Azel
message: 「Then stop doing it. Get back to work」

name: Pasta
message: 「I'm going back without you telling me to, nya... sigh」
Looks like their talk is over for now.

name: Synn
message: 「Heeey, Azel!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Gah. S-See ya, nya!」
It's a bit of a shock when someone runs away from me.
Well, I guess it can't be helped, though.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel, are you close with Pasta--the Waitress?」

name: Azel
message: 「No」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, you guys looked pretty friendly」

name: Azel
message: 「You're imagining things」

name: Synn
message: 「But... wait, where are you going, Azel!? That's not the way to the library」

name: Synn
message: 「At least learn how to transfer data」
Transferring the photo data filling up the digital camera's memory to the PC.

name: Azel
message: 「You're here, so it's not a problem」

name: Synn
message: 「It's better if you can do it yourself--you can organize the data too, you know」

name: Azel
message: 「You'll do it, so it's not a problem」
Transferring data from a digital camera and saving it to a PC is easy, yet he refuses to learn how to do it.

name: Synn
message: 「There. All done. You sure take a lot of pictures, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「It is not enough.」
Looking back, Azel was gazing at the monitor with a lonely expression.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「I have not captured enough.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even with all these?」

name: Azel
message: 「This world is overflowing with precious moments.」
Azel's words carried a faint warmth.

name: Azel
message: 「However, the instant I point my camera, that jewel-like moment has already passed. Only the trace of the jewel remains in the photograph. It is frustrating.」

name: Azel
message: 「There must be a way to capture it. After all, photographers certainly succeed in capturing those moments. Is it technique? Sensibility? Equipment? Most likely, I lack all of them.」

name: Synn
message: 「You've really changed since you discovered photography, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Is that so.」
An ambiguous reply, neither affirming nor denying.
It would have been unthinkable for the old Azel.

name: Synn
message: 「Don't get me wrong. I don't mean it in a bad way.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel, do you remember the very first photo you took at Kirafes? The one of the Lost Boy.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have a good memory.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I mean. Um, back then, how were you able to take that photo? Before you took a picture of that kid, you couldn't take any at all.」

name: Azel
message: 「I feared waste.」
"It is pointless." That used to be one of Azel's favorite catchphrases.

name: Azel
message: 「Time is finite.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sounds kind of complicated.」

name: Azel
message: 「Furthermore, the number of photos one can take is also finite.」

name: Synn
message: 「True. The memory card really did fill up like this, after all.」

name: Azel
message: 「If I shoot something pointless, I might miss a scene I truly ought to capture. Yet every scene holds a captivating moment, until everything looks worth photographing.」

name: Azel
message: 「I didn't know what I should photograph. As a result, I was afraid of taking pointless action. While I hesitated, the scenes I wanted to capture vanished」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why that kid?」
Azel gave a small laugh.

name: Azel
message: 「The moment I saw the smile that child directed my way, I pressed the shutter. And I understood just one thing」

name: Azel
message: 「Everything is fleeting. If you don't capture it the instant you feel the urge, it disappears. Because beauty only manifests in this single, present moment」

name: Azel
message: 「That's why I take photos. I can't help but take them」
A lively voice.

name: Azel
message: 「Did you know? That this world is full of beautiful moments」

name: Azel
message: 「A shopping district with its shutters closed early in the morning, an empty school building, wispy clouds drifting across the winter sky, a blue sky crisp in the cold air」

name: Azel
message: 「Students running around the field, students chatting in the courtyard, the side profiles of the Student Council members when they're making idle chatter--」
His voice abruptly cut off.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you okay!?」
Crouching down while clutching his chest, Azel clearly looked unwell, so I rushed over, but--

name: Azel
message: 「I'm fine」
he said, brusquely swatting my hand away.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, you look like you're in pain」
When I placed my hand on his forehead, it felt a little hot......

name: Azel
message: 「What are you doing!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry. I thought you might have a fever」

name: Azel
message: 「Of course I do」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I meant. Do you normally run a higher body temperature, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Not interested. I wouldn't know」
Saying that, Azel braced his hand against the desk and stood up.
He's staggering a little.

name: Synn
message: 「You should go home. I'll walk you back」

name: Azel
message: 「I made a promise to you」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't even study when you're feeling sick.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm fine... for the sake of ramen.」
So that's what it's about.

name: Synn
message: 「You're not feeling well today, so we won't count it.」

name: Azel
message: 「Even if we don't do it today, you'll still treat me to ramen, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Azel
message: 「...Then I'm going home.」
Is this really okay? Studying for tests just being a bonus for ramen.

name: Mysterious Man
message: 「F-From Pasta-chan!? From Pasta-chan to me!?」

name: Mysterious Man
message: 「Ooooooh! My charm has finally gotten through to her!」

name: Arden
message: 「It's Arden. Pasta-chaaan♪」

name: Arden
message: 「What is it, what is it? If it's a favor from you, I'll do anything, y'know?」

name: Arden
message: 「...W-Whaaat!? You're being bullied!?」

name: Arden
message: 「You're being bullied by those Student Council guys!!」

name: Arden
message: 「Got it! I'll beat them up for you!」
